<!--
NOTES FROM THE SCRIPTS (delete after writing):
- LTA DataMall "Passenger volume by origin destination train stations" and
  "... bus stops": monthly, by day type and hour. Sample months: March, June,
  September, December. MRT 2021-03 to 2026-09 (Train_all.Rmd); bus 2020-03 to
  2026-09 (Bus_SDand_After SD.Rmd), weekday 06:00-10:00 for bus.
- Converted to Parquet (R/od_io.R) because the raw CSVs total ~20 GB; bus stop
  codes read as text to keep leading zeros.
- URA Master Plan 2019 Subzone Boundary (No Sea): centre definitions and
  service-shed units.
- URA Master Plan 2019 Land Use layer (amended): land-use mix of the centres
  (additional dataset not listed in the brief).
- OpenStreetMap points of interest via a Geofabrik extract (osmextract):
  dining, retail, leisure, daily needs, community, nightlife (additional
  dataset; ODbL licence).
- LTA MRT station exits + official station code list: station locations,
  joined to OD station codes (interchanges such as "EW24/NS1" split).
- LTA bus stop locations (LTABusStop.geojson).
- Licences: LTA DataMall and URA data under the Singapore Open Data Licence;
  OSM under ODbL ("(c) OpenStreetMap contributors").
-->

# Methods

<!-- WRITING GUIDE: explain each step so it can be reproduced. Notes on what
the code does are listed below. -->

[Methods]

<!--
NOTES FROM THE SCRIPTS (delete after writing):
- Centres = sets of subzones (CBD: 12 subzones incl. Raffles Place, Marina
  Centre...; Jurong: Jurong Gateway, International Business Park, Lakeside x2;
  Woodlands: North Coast, Woodlands Regional Centre; Tampines: North/West/East).
- Periods: AM peak 06-09h, PM peak 17-20h (weekday), weekday off-peak,
  weekend/holiday.
- COVID phases (after Hou et al. 2025): "SD control" up to 2022-03,
  "Non-control" after.
- Indicators per centre: attraction = inflow / island-wide trips;
  in/out ratio = inflow / outflow; CBD outflow share = trips to CBD / outflow;
  mean trip distance = trip-weighted straight-line distance of trips entering
  the centre.
- Service shed: origin subzones ranked by monthly-average trips into a centre;
  cumulative share 0-25 % = core, 25-50 % strong, 50-75 % weak, 75-100 %
  peripheral. Principal shed = core + strong.
- Overlap O(i, j) = share of centre j's principal-shed subzones that are also
  in centre i's; diagonal = self-containment (share not shared with any other
  centre).
- Land use: Master Plan land-use polygons intersected with the centres,
  grouped into five categories; POIs counted per km2 of each centre.
-->

# Results

## Trip indicators

<!-- WRITING GUIDE: describe what the tables show, with numbers. Compare the
centres and the two phases. -->

```{r tab-mrt}
mrt <- read_tab("mrt_indicator_means")
if (is.null(mrt)) {
  missing_note("outputs/tables/mrt_indicator_means.rds")
} else {
  mrt |>
    filter(period == "AM peak") |>
    mutate(attraction        = attraction * 100,
           cbd_outflow_share = cbd_outflow_share * 100) |>
    stylized_table(
      cols   = c(Phase = covid_phase, Centre = zone,
                 `Attraction (%)` = attraction, `In/out ratio` = in_out_ratio,
                 `CBD outflow (%)` = cbd_outflow_share,
                 `Mean distance (km)` = mean_dist_km),
      group  = Phase, digits = 2,
      title  = "Table 1. MRT/LRT indicators by centre, weekday AM peak (monthly means).",
      note   = "Source: LTA DataMall passenger volume by OD (train). CBD outflow share is not defined for the CBD.")
}
```

[Interpretation of Table 1]

```{r tab-bus}
bus <- read_tab("bus_indicator_means")
if (is.null(bus)) {
  missing_note("outputs/tables/bus_indicator_means.rds")
} else {
  bus |>
    rename(Centre = zone) |>
    stylized_table(
      group = Centre, digits = 2,
      title = "Table 2. Bus indicators by centre, weekday AM peak (monthly means).",
      note  = "Source: LTA DataMall passenger volume by OD (bus).")
}
```

[Interpretation of Table 2]
